# 🎉 Welcome / 欢迎贡献

## English
Thank you for taking the time to contribute.

> ⚠️ **Guidelines:**
> 1. **New Features:** Before writing code for a new feature, **please open an Issue first** to discuss it.
> 2. **Typos & Grammar:** Please **DO NOT** open PRs *solely* for fixing minor typos, formatting, or grammar issues in documentation/comments.

### Description
### Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (I have opened an Issue and discussed it beforehand)
- [ ] 🛠️ Refactoring / Tech debt (changes to internal architecture or performance)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation / i18n update

### Developer Checklist
- [ ] I have run `make fmt` to format the code.
- [ ] I have run `make lint` and resolved any warnings.
- [ ] My code builds and runs successfully.
- [ ] ⚖️ **I have read and agree to the [Contributor License Agreement](CLA.md).**
- [ ] (Optional) I have tested this on: [ ] macOS / [ ] Windows / [ ] Linux.
---

## 中文
感谢你贡献代码。

> ⚠️ **指南：**
> 1. **关于新特性：** 在编写新功能的代码前，**请务必先提交 Issue 进行讨论**。
> 2. **关于拼写与语法：** 请 **不要** 提交仅仅为了修复文档/注释中个别拼写、格式或语法错误的 PR。

### 变动描述
### 变动类型
- [ ] 🐛 Bug 修复
- [ ] ✨ 新特性（我已提前提交 Issue 并经过了讨论）
- [ ] 🛠️ 代码重构 / 性能优化
- [ ] 📝 文档完善 / 多语言 (i18n) 更新

### 开发者自查表
- [ ] 我已运行 `make fmt` 格式化代码。
- [ ] 我已运行 `make lint` 并修复了所有警告。
- [ ] 我的代码可以在本地成功编译并运行。
- [ ] ⚖️ **我已阅读并同意 [贡献者许可协议](CLA.md)。**
- [ ] (可选) 我已在以下平台进行过测试： [ ] macOS / [ ] Windows / [ ] Linux。
